name: LiLU (Learned Implicit Local Uniformity) Constraint
definition: A custom PyTorch autograd function used to enforce constraints on input tensors, specifically handling boundary conditions where values are less than or equal to zero.
summary: LiLU is a PyTorch autograd function that enforces non-negative boundary conditions by zeroing non-positive values and blocking positive gradients, ensuring differentiable constraint handling in neural rendering.
